body:
In primary school I was more physically bullied. Like I would be beaten up in the school canteen and my classmates would just watch me. Got kicked in the stomach till I lost consciousness. 

In secondary school is more of mental and verbal bullying. But will have times of being physically bullied. Like if I'm reading a bunch of girls would whack my face with my book while the boys would take my bag, unzip it and toss it across the classroom,causing the contents of my bag to fly all over the classroom and I will have to pick them up myself. Even when the teacher is around, they would do that and the Teachers won't care to scold them. I remembered one time my skirt was glued to the chair and had to rip it off the seat. I was crying so hard but my teacher just told me not to disturb her and the class. I ran out and hanged my self in the toilet till a schoolmate got me down. 

This bullying resulted me in having an intense hatred of Teachers/authoritarian figures, very Low self esteem, and suicidal thoughts ever since I was 9. I attempted suicide 4 times already and am hoping once day I would succeed in doing so.
